description: Mint a signed typed receipt for any transaction or action. use it rather than `issue_attestation` for attestation receipt, not attestation; an object with 26 fields including action, actor. $0.25 USDC.

action.description: The action being recorded or evaluated.
action.title: Action

actor.description: Who performed the action. Used to attribute the record and to check the authority of the caller.
actor.title: Actor

metadata.description: Free-form metadata recorded with the result.
metadata.title: Metadata

receipt_type.description: The receipt type this operation operates on. See the schema for its type and whether it is required.
receipt_type.title: Receipt Type

subject.description: The subject the operation is applied to — an id, a URL or a name, depending on the operation.
subject.title: Subject

tx.description: The tx this operation operates on. See the schema for its type and whether it is required.
tx.title: Tx

name: issue_attestation_receipt

note.description: A note on how the answer was produced.

signature.description: The Ed25519 signature over the evidence core, base64-encoded.

title: Issue Attestation Receipt
